def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    r0=c0=None
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(w-2):
            if all(row[c+i] for i in range(3)):
                r0,c0=r,c; break
        if r0 is not None: break
    if r0 is None: return out
    left,mid,right=grid[r0][c0:c0+3]
    for color, sc, direction in ((left,c0,-1),(right,c0+2,1)):
        markers=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color and r!=r0 or grid[r][c]==color and c not in range(c0,c0+3)]
        if markers:
            r,c=markers[0]
            for y in range(min(r,r0),max(r,r0)+1): out[y][sc]=color
            for x in range(min(c,sc),max(c,sc)+1): out[r][x]=color
    for r in range(h):
        if r!=r0: out[r][c0+1]=mid
    return out
